title: 第1356章 内忧外患第1355章 大帝
lines: 高山进入到天庭遗迹内，眉头紧锁，心思沉重。
按照潘老爷子所说，他们可不只是有着外来修炼者这些外患。
像是魏家的这位长生大帝似的古天神很可能成为内忧的。
内忧外患中，医门该如何面对呢？
高山露出无奈苦笑。
罢了！
他现在想再多也没用，到时兵来将挡水来土掩吧！
他坚信华夏不会就此灭族。
他现在要做的就是尽人事，高山回来后也抓紧修炼起来，同时各种灵石以及其它所需资源也在被送来。
修炼过一段时间后，哮天犬送消息过来告知高山，宁城那边已经支撑不了多久了，因为那边已经被对方突破的支离破碎，彻底破开再无法封堵只是时间的问题，而且开始有修炼者不停的渗透进来。
高山收到消息后立即带人去镇守，而且医门的人恰好也需要人来练手，那些渗透进来的人就是送给他们的对象。
不过让高山没想到的是渗透进来的人越来越多，实力也越来越强，在拼杀中还是给医门造成了些伤亡。
起先，高山很愤怒，渐渐地也坦然接受了，因为他知道从这一刻起便相当于战争彻底爆发了。
而全面的大战也不远了。
高山命令下去，中医院搬到宁城外，以作为后勤保障。中医院就在战场后方，有伤者出现能第一时间就得到救治。
他还命令人将宁城外的村庄以及城镇的人全部撤走，强行进行撤离，因为一旦全面爆发战争，战斗区域随时会被扩大。
所有一切都准备妥当后，就等着修炼者大军杀来。
这天，天地震动，苍穹上裂开一道道缝隙。
咔咔咔……
一声声碎裂声振聋发聩。
高山望向天空都感觉心神颤抖，因为有种天要碎裂塌陷的感觉。
轰隆隆……
接着是隆隆巨响，整个天地都在颤抖。
医门的人对此已经有些习惯了，他们知道是外来修炼者又一次的在轰击空间壁垒，只是这一次搞出的动静要大的多。
很快，天上开始破开一个个的洞，无数的修炼者从天而降。
孟星河虽全力去封堵，可惜这次打开的裂开太多了，根本就封堵不及。
“准备战斗！”高山呼喊着。
所有医门人都列开阵势严阵以待。
这次闯入的外来修炼者很多，密密麻麻的，而且孕婴大能也要多的多，站立在虚空中足有数百人。
外来修炼者也不废话，直接进行冲杀。
他们不敢久留这里，因为担心孟星河封堵住裂口会对他们出手，所以必须先冲出这里。
高山呼喊道:“所有人散开，呈队列交替应战，尽量减少伤亡。”
content_en:
Gao Shan entered the ruins of Heaven, his brows furrowed and his mind heavy.
According to Mr. Pan, they don't just have external troubles such as foreign cultivators.
An ancient god like the Immortal Emperor of the Wei family is likely to become a source of internal trouble.
How should the medical community face internal and external troubles?
Gao Shan smiled helplessly.
That’s it!
It's useless no matter how much he thinks about it now. When the soldiers come, the water will be blocked and the earth will cover it up!
He firmly believed that China would not be exterminated.
What he has to do now is to do his best. After Gao Shan returns, he will also hurry up and start practicing. At the same time, various spiritual stones and other needed resources are also being sent.
After practicing for a period of time, Roaring Sky Dog sent a message to Gao Shan to tell Gao Shan that Ningcheng's side could not hold on for much longer because it had been broken into pieces by the opponent. It was only a matter of time before it was completely broken and could no longer be blocked, and practitioners began to infiltrate incessantly.
After receiving the news, Gao Shan immediately took people to guard the area, and the medical staff also happened to need people to practice their skills. Those who infiltrated were the ones given to them.
However, what Gao Shan didn't expect was that more and more people infiltrated and became stronger and stronger, and they still caused some casualties to the medical sect during the fight.
At first, Gao Shan was very angry, but gradually he accepted it calmly, because he knew that from this moment on, the war was equivalent to a complete outbreak.
And a full-scale war is not far away.
Gao Shan ordered him to go down and move the traditional Chinese medicine hospital outside Ningcheng as logistical support. The hospital of traditional Chinese medicine is right behind the battlefield, and the injured can receive treatment as soon as they appear.
He also ordered people to evacuate all the people from the villages and towns outside Ningcheng and force the evacuation, because once a full-scale war breaks out, the combat area will be expanded at any time.
After everything is ready, wait for the army of cultivators to come.
On this day, the heaven and earth shook, and cracks opened in the sky.
Click, click, click...
The sound of shattering was deafening.
Gaoshan felt his heart tremble when he looked at the sky, because he felt like the sky was about to break and collapse.
Rumble…
Then there was a loud rumble, and the whole world trembled.
The people in the medical sect have become somewhat accustomed to this. They know that outside cultivators are once again bombarding the space barrier, but this time the movement is much greater.
Soon, holes began to open in the sky, and countless cultivators fell from the sky.
Although Meng Xinghe tried his best to seal it, it was a pity that there were too many cracks opened this time and it was impossible to seal it.
"Get ready to fight!" Gao Shan shouted.
All the medical staff formed a formation and were ready.
There were many foreign cultivators who broke in this time, and they were densely packed, and there were also many more powerful pregnant women. There were hundreds of them standing in the void.
"Kill!"
The outside cultivators didn't waste any time and went straight to kill them.
They didn't dare to stay here for a long time because they were worried that Meng Xinghe would attack them if he blocked the crack, so they had to rush out of here first.
Gao Shan shouted: "Everyone spread out and formed a queue to fight alternately to minimize casualties."
